Premium Lite is not a strict same-service streaming row, but same-country bundle undercut and the user's market-reality concern justify a strong bounded positive transfer-pressure score.

FLO likely faces some Korean-market transfer pressure from Apple Music, but the current case is only weakly supported because no direct same-period transfer panel has been built for this pair.
KakaoWebtoon plausibly faces Korean-market transfer pressure through discoverability, foreign brand pull, and app-store dependence, but the current evidence remains thin and identification-weak.
KakaoPage versus Piccoma is retained because cross-platform transfer pressure matters strategically, but the current Korean-market evidence is especially thin and partly cross-market.
